crossRefs.note: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.
the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

people.name: Abijah
people.line: Son of Samuel, a corrupt judge

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Joel
people.line: Samuel's firstborn son who judged Israel

translations.web: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
translations.bsb: The name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second was Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
translations.kjv: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abiah: they were judges in Beersheba.
translations.asv: Now the name of his first-born was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah: they were judges in Beer-sheba.
